From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pre-sales: GPU fleet interview guide and quick traffic probe

Hi Asha — great context, thanks for the sample. I attached our short probe template (XLSX) to make answers quick; if you prefer, fill the CSV columns we sent and we can ingest it.

Key things we need to recommend a safe dedicated starting footprint:
- Traffic shape: sustained tokens/day, burst QPS windows (start/end timestamps) and expected burst duration in minutes.
- Prompt/response length distribution: percentile table (p50/p90/p99) for both prompt tokens and response tokens.
- Session model: are sessions stateful (KV cache reuse) or stateless per request? If stateful, average KV cache size in tokens.
- Concurrency mix: fraction of requests that are synchronous vs. background (batch) and expected concurrency per model.
- Model family & comp targets: which open model(s) you plan to use (e.g., MPT-30B, Llama2-13B-q4) and any quantization constraints.
- SLA targets: p50/p95/p99 latency SLOs and acceptable rate of fallback to cheaper tiers.
- Growth plan & timelines: anticipated 3/6/12 month multipliers and pilot cutover date.

Quick asks we can take now (if you prefer to answer inline):
1) Peak sustained minutes per day (approx):
2) Longest expected burst window (minutes) and peak burst QPS:
3) Prompt token p90 and response token p90 (est):
4) Percent of requests that reuse a session KV cache:
5) Preferred model(s) for pilot:

If you fill the attached workbook, Ben and I will run a conservative GPU-mix + canary routing plan and share a short one-pager.

Best,
Karthik
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ri_pre-sales_probe_template.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-12T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pre-sales: GPU fleet interview guide and quick traffic probe

Karthik — looping in a quick thought on SKU mix. Based on Asha's initial note (p99 target 250ms, peak QPS ~18, 1.3M tokens/day):
- Start with a small dedicated pool: 3x A100-80GB equiv oversubscribed for steady-state (handles KV sessions + batching) + 1x p99-optimized node (lower-latency GPU) as a hot path for time-sensitive traffic.
- Use autoscale buffer + burst reservation (2x baseline) for predictable launches.
- If they'd use Llama2-13B-qa quantized, we can pack ~6 sessions per GPU with continuous batching; MPT-30B will need more capacity.

I'll grab Ben for cost/ops details.

—Marissa

Thanks — I filled the XLSX and attached it. Answers inline for quick reference:
- Peak sustained minutes/day: ~720 minutes (daily peak window)
- Longest burst: 14 minutes, peak burst QPS: 36
- Prompt token p90: 48, response token p90: 220
- Session reuse: ~62% requests reuse session context, average KV size ~1.2k tokens
- Pilot model: Llama2-13B-4bit quantized; fallback to Llama2-7B for lower-cost routing
- Growth: planning 2.5x within 6 months if pilot KPIs met

Attached: novatune_filled_probe.xlsx and the original sample CSV.

Let us know if you need any telemetry slices.

Asha

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Asha Iqbal <asha@novatune.ai>
Date: 2028-07-15T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final sizing notes and next steps

Thanks for the workbook, Asha — clear and helpful. TL;DR sizing recommendation attached as a short note. Key decisions and next steps:

- Recommended pilot fleet: baseline 3x A100-80GB-equivalent with 1 hot low-latency node (total 4 nodes) + burst reservation of 2 nodes for predictable surges. This maps to our Dedicated SKU: D3-standard + D3-hot pair.
- Rationale: session reuse (62%) yields good KV cache hit-rate; batching will reduce per-token cost while meeting p99 250ms for most requests. Llama2-13B-q4 will require the baseline nodes; route 20% of traffic to 7B fallback during high-burst windows to preserve p99.
- Canary & rollouts: 2-week pilot, canary at 5% traffic for first 48 hours, monitor token cost, p99 latency, and KV eviction rates.

Action items:
- Asha/procurement: confirm pilot start week and whether NovaTune needs SOC2 evidence before deploy (we can provide SOC2 report + audit logs).
- Marissa/Ben: produce SKU-level cost estimate and a one-page runbook for on-call ops.
- Karthik (me): deliver a brief playbook and the D3 mapping PDF.

[Attachment: fleet-sizing-notes.pdf (pdf)]

I'll schedule a 30-minute review next week to walk through the playbook. Quick calendar options: Tue 10:00-10:30 or Wed 14:00-14:30 PT.

Best,
Karthik
